name: auryn-cuda
summary: CUDA language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cuda engine. CUDA is a superset of C++, so it reuses the auryn-cpp extraction engine verbatim (namespaces/classes/structs/enums/methods/fields/params, type hierarchy, templates, includes/macros, calls) and adds the CUDA-only graph signals: an `execution_space` property (`__global__`/`__device__`/`__host__`) and a LAUNCHES edge for `kernel<<<...>>>` launches. A deep libclang/nvcc pass is the planned second phase.
